scope: CPU FP32 512px-context qualitative check of completed fresh no-context10000 and retained V43 on standing DSCF3879/3880 pair; no new full-frame output, reference scoring or promotion.

selection.notes: GFX100S / 55mm. Noisy DSCF3879: ISO6400, f/1.7, 1/240s, 17:13:27. Reference DSCF3880: ISO100, f/5.6, 3s, 17:17:05. Captured 3m38s apart with nearly identical framing. Aperture, depth of field, clouds, lights and moving subjects still differ. Native sensor crops with input/reference-only integer coordinate matching; no resizing or warping, no per-panel brightness adjustment. Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.

sky_input_consistency.scope: Full512 context; four phase means in linear sensor units. Differences relative to the noisy input, not a quality score or comparison to the independent ISO100 frame; no noise-independence confidence claim.

visual_review.sky: All methods remove most visible grain; comparison to the separately exposed ISO100 frame is qualitative.
visual_review.building: The learned models remain close; fine bracket/truss detail is softened. Reference aperture/motion differences prevent assigning every gap to the models.
visual_review.foliage: V43 and no-context10000 stay close and soften fine leaf texture.
visual_review.fence: Both learned models retain more continuous mesh lines than the two RawNIND variants; a clear new winner over V43 is not established.
visual_review.reference: ISO100 f/5.6, 3s, captured3m38 later than ISO6400 f/1.7,1/240; independently AHD-demosaiced/own-CFA-calibrated, qualitative only; never exact GT.

decision.next: Finish original S/B and complete matched numerical/native/analytic/full-frame GFX review before recipe/model selection.
